listing.name: Gears of War: Judgment (Gears of War: Judgement Recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for Gears of War: Judgement Recomp; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Early release; upstream campaign boots/plays but tests only beginning. Preserve incomplete campaign coverage and Xenia-derived system/graphics layer. Early release single-player beginning only; campaign breadth incomplete, not full verified playability. Windowsx64 ReXGlue graphics/system emulation despite native CPU. Upstream platforms: Windows x64 ReXGlue runtime. Other native player hosts not established; original Xbox360 edition. Original data: Xbox360 GearsOfWarJudgment retail titleID own default.xex and data. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
